title: Move c10/util/TypeCast.h and overflows.h into torch/headeronly
body: ## Summary Move `TypeCast.h` and `overflows.h` from `c10/util` into `torch/headeronly/util` under `torch::headeronly`, leaving the old `c10/util` paths as one-line forwarding includes (matching `Half.h` / `BFloat16.h`). `TypeCast.h`'s `report_overflow` used to be a `C10_API` symbol defined in `TypeCast.cpp` so the `ostringstream`/`throw` path was not inlined into every `checked_convert` instantiation (see #65830 / #66721). Header-only code cannot export that symbol, and inlining it directly could reintroduced the code-size bloat. We therefore add the `C10_NOINLINE` macro with `inline` so the overflow path is still not inlined into every `checked_convert` instantiation. Removed the now-dead `//c10/util:TypeCast` Bazel target and its two dependents (`c10/build.bzl`, `c10/core/build.bzl`), since `TypeCast.cpp` no longer exists. This is the second leaf-utilities PR toward moving aten/src/ATen/native/Math.h and its dependency chain into headeronly. (This should be independent of the first PR #194673, and should not have any merge conflicts with it) cc @janeyx99 ## Test plan `build/bin/test_aoti_abi_check --gtest_filter='TestCast.*:TestOverflows.*'` ## Test Result
